name: Bold Color List
description: A bold list animation that reveals color swatches in a clean row. Ideal for palette showcases and minimal brand presentations.

name: Color Cards: Cascade
description: A cascading card animation that drops color swatches in sequence. Great for palette walkthroughs and layered brand reveals.

name: Color Cards: Expand
description: Animated color swatches that expand and collapse. Perfect for palette showcases and brand style guides.

name: Color Cards: Scale
description: A scaling card animation that grows color swatches into view. Perfect for palette reveals and design system showcases.

name: Color Cards: Stack
description: A stacking card animation that piles color swatches into a clean grid. Ideal for palette displays and design system presentations.

name: Color Pills: Reveal
description: A pill-shaped color reveal that pops swatches in one by one. Great for palette showcases and playful brand intros.

name: Color Ring: Bounce Reveal
description: A bouncing ring animation that pops color orbs into view. Great for playful palette reveals and vibrant brand moments.

name: The Edit: Brand Promo
description: A brand promo template with bold typography and quick cuts. Perfect for social media ads and campaign content where you need to make an impression fast.

name: The Edit: Collection Teaser
description: A teaser template for revealing a new collection with slow builds and dramatic reveals. Perfect for fashion drops and product collection launches.

name: The Edit: Duo
description: A two-panel edit template with synchronized motion across both frames. Good for before/after reveals and side-by-side product comparisons.

name: The Edit: Fragrance Promo
description: A slow atmospheric promo template with cinematic cuts and a luxurious pace. Works well for fragrance beauty and luxury product advertising.

name: The Edit: Poppy
description: A vibrant edit template with bright colors and fast transitions. Made for lifestyle brands and social content that wants energy and movement.

name: The Edit: Split Reveal
description: A split-screen template that opens up to reveal content behind it. Works for dramatic product launches and cinematic title sequences.

name: The Edit: Trio
description: A three-panel edit template with synchronized motion across all frames. Good for side-by-side product comparisons and triple showcases.

name: The Track: Poster
description: A motivational poster animation pairing big type with athlete imagery. Perfect for campaign hero shots and sports brand promos.

name: The Track: Product Reveal
description: A product reveal template with kinetic motion and a strong pace. Great for product launches and e-commerce promotional videos where the buildup matters.
